slice: P3 selected unmarked MATERIAL file-backed normal filename edit
scope: Unchanged captured modern-DXF MATERIAL source with an inferred complete normal tuple, normal source 1 and qualified common carrier; typed filename edit alone or composed with selected normal blend/projection/tiling/auto-transform edits.

contract.operation: Bind exactly two outer group-3 string fields around the inferred second group-42 boundary, preserve the diffuse filename and use the target-format strict UTF-8 encoder for the normal filename. Re-decode and match the entire represented emitted model.
contract.atomicity: Invalid UTF-8, embedded NUL, excessive retained bytes, changed diffuse/source/presence, conflicting raw fields, unqualified procedural fields and late mutations refuse without replacing the destination or caller state; corrected retry uses the same adapter.
contract.unqualified: Group-72 source changes and their coupling with filename/procedural data, native text/file resolution, rendering, other source profiles, opaque/caret cross-format source replay and whole-document conversion.

validation.focusedControls: Five filename forms (plain, UTF-8, literal caret, literal Unicode-escape text and empty) across four ASCII/binary source/output routes; four selected combined-field exports; 28 invalid, resource-bound, changed context/presence and raw-conflict refusal/retries; six late-callback refusal/retries; 24 procedural-field refusal/retries. Existing source common-carrier, ownership and replay controls continue.
validation.chronology: Normal and ASan used frozen code committed as above. The independent text projection was rerun against the freshly built shared normal adapter and library.

independentPeer.derivation: The retained selected source removes unrelated EZDXF_META root and DICTIONARY/DICTIONARYVAR objects; its selected MATERIAL identity and all 55 host fields match the independently authored original before document setup.
independentPeer.observations: Independent pre-setup physical-tag loader verified all 55 selected MATERIAL body fields unchanged except the second group 3. It applied one target-specific text decode and compared the intended Unicode, caret and literal escape strings in both encodings.

limitations: Autodesk names normal map group 72 but does not specify its numeric values or inactive filename coupling in the MATERIAL DXF table. Existing modeled 0/1 admission is not a native semantic certificate.
The independently authored peer experiment uses a derived source with unrelated objects removed; it is not proof of whole-document fidelity.
No native CAD rendering, file lookup behavior, DWG parity, arbitrary profile or broad support claim follows. No drawing fixture is committed.
